definitions.explanation: The central or innermost part of something.
The string in a candle that burns.
The graphite stick inside a mechanical pencil.

examples.japanese: {鉛筆|えんぴつ}の{芯|しん}が{折|お}れた。
{体|からだ}の{芯|しん}から{冷|ひ}えた。
examples.english: I was chilled to the bone.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{芯|しん}の{強|つよ}い{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: She is a person with inner strength.

notes:
{芯|しん} refers to the core or center of things, both literally and figuratively.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {芯|しん}から (from the core, thoroughly)
- {芯|しん}が{強|つよ}い (having inner strength)
- {体|からだ}の{芯|しん} (the core of one's body)
- {替|か}え{芯|しん} (replacement lead for mechanical pencil)
- {芯|しん}が{折|お}れる (the lead breaks)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {芯|しん}まで (all the way through)
- {芯|しん}のある (having substance, backbone)
